signature.name: VTask.copy
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {A : Type u_2} -> {B : Type u_3} -> [Monoid R] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] -> [DistribMulAction R A] -> [Star A] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring B] -> [DistribMulAction R B] -> [Star B] -> (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[R] B) -> (f' : A → B) -> (h : f' = ⇑f) -> A →⋆ₙₐ[R] B

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.copy is a total constructor; given any f, f', and a proof h : f' = ⇑f, it always produces a well-formed morphism. There are no junk-value conventions or special edge-case assignments.

facts.statement: ∀ {R A B : Type*} [Monoid R] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] [DistribMulAction R A] [Star A] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring B] [DistribMulAction R B] [Star B] (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[R] B) (f' : A → B) (h : f' = ⇑f), VTask.copy f f' h = f
